Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite sheet of ONE car model with SIXTEEN distinctly different 3D yaw poses. Reference is a model/style reference, not a layout to copy. Use ONLY the rounded compact three-door hatchback in reference ROW ONE; exclude all other models. Keep this exact design, body dimensions, paint details, lights, wheels, windows and trim consistent in every frame. Original realistic painted miniatures, smooth antialiased edges, not pixel art. Body panels saturated MAGENTA/PINK for recoloring; charcoal glass, black tires, neutral silver trim. Fixed 30-degree overhead orthographic camera. Transparent alpha background, no floor, no background color, no shadows, grid, labels or text.

EXACT REGULAR FOUR COLUMNS BY FOUR ROWS, sixteen complete isolated sprites of this SAME car. Each car centred within its equal cell with at least 15% clear margin, absolutely no overlap or clipping.

Four columns show four VERY DIFFERENT projected nose angles. Angles below are screen-space: x is horizontal, y is vertical. Camera elevation and car dimensions are fixed; physically rotate each car in 3D yaw. Do not simply rotate a flat bitmap. 
COLUMN 1: car's LONG AXIS tilted ONLY 13 DEGREES from horizontal: almost horizontal broad SIDE VIEW, only a little end visible.
COLUMN 2: long axis tilted 42 DEGREES from horizontal: strongly diagonal three-quarter view.
COLUMN 3: long axis tilted 58 DEGREES from horizontal: steeper three-quarter view, more end than side.
COLUMN 4: long axis tilted 74 DEGREES from horizontal: ALMOST VERTICAL, nearly symmetric end view, only a narrow strip of side visible.
The change from column 1 to 4 must be obvious: wide side silhouette to narrow end silhouette, NOT four similar diagonal poses.

ROW 1: car's NOSE points UP-RIGHT (away from viewer). Rear bumper and tail lamps visible. Across the row its screen direction rotates from almost RIGHT to almost UP: -13, -42, -58, -74 degrees.
ROW 2: NOSE points DOWN-RIGHT (towards viewer). Headlamps/front grille visible. Directions +13, +42, +58, +74 degrees from screen right.
ROW 3: NOSE points DOWN-LEFT (towards viewer). Headlamps/front grille visible. Directions 167, 138, 122, 106 degrees from screen right.
ROW 4: NOSE points UP-LEFT (away from viewer). Rear bumper/tail lamps visible. Directions 193, 222, 238, 254 degrees from screen right.
Maintain consistent real-world length, camera angle and lighting across all sixteen poses; projected screen silhouette naturally gets NARROWER as the car points more vertically. No exactly horizontal, vertical or standard 26.6-degree isometric poses: these new frames fill gaps between existing ones. Real transparent background.
